benchmark_common.model: GPT-2-class: 12 layers, model_dim=768, 6 heads x 128 head_dim (attn), MLP hdim=4*768, RMSNorm (gain), RoPE, relu().square() activation, logit soft-cap 15, vocab 50304
benchmark_common.precision: params fp32 + compiled fwd (bf16 embed/NS internals)
benchmark_common.dist: torchrun NCCL, world_size 1/2/4/8 (assert 8%ws==0), grad all-reduce SUM; H100x8 in public runs
benchmark_common.ns: steps=12, coeff=(2.0,-1.5,0.5), bf16, norm+1e-7, same for ALL three recipes

recipe.matrix_optimizer: MuonH per shape-class (qkv / mlp.fc / attn.proj / mlp.proj as 4 separate optimizer instances, same hypers, for compile-cache)
recipe.hyperball: per-matrix: p_norm=||W||; step=lr*update*p_norm/clamp(||update||,1e-10); renorm to p_norm; eps=1e-10
recipe.init: PyTorch default Kaiming-uniform (nn.Linear) then multipliers: attn.proj x1.25, mlp.proj x3.0, mlp.fc x1.5; head proj.weight=0, all proj biases=0, embed=default
recipe.aux_optimizer: AdamW fused: embed lr=0.3, head lr=1/320, 1D lr=0.01, betas=(0.8,0.95), eps=1e-10, wd=0
recipe.schedule: linear-to-zero cooldown, NO warmup: matrix cooldown_frac=1.0, aux cooldown_frac=0.4
